Settings.QueryText: SELECT CatalogRoomQuotas.Ref AS Ref, CatalogRoomQuotas.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, CatalogRoomQuotas.Parent AS Parent, CatalogRoomQuotas.IsFolder AS IsFolder, CatalogRoomQuotas.Code AS Code, CatalogRoomQuotas.Description AS Description, CatalogRoomQuotas.Agent AS Agent, CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType AS AllotmentType, CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentBusinessType AS AllotmentBusinessType, CatalogRoomQuotas.Author AS Author, CatalogRoomQuotas.BaseRoomQuota AS BaseRoomQuota, CatalogRoomQuotas.ChargingFolio AS ChargingFolio, CatalogRoomQuotas.Color AS Color, CatalogRoomQuotas.Company AS Company, CatalogRoomQuotas.Contract AS Contract, CatalogRoomQuotas.ContactPerson AS ContactPerson, CatalogRoomQuotas.CreateDate AS CreateDate, CatalogRoomQuotas.Customer AS Customer, CatalogRoomQuotas.CustomerOrContractChangeIsNotAllowed AS CustomerOrContractChangeIsNotAllowed, CatalogRoomQuotas.DoCharge AS DoCharge, CatalogRoomQuotas.DoWriteOff AS DoWriteOff, CatalogRoomQuotas.FlatRateIsUsedForUnderallotmentPenaltyCalculation AS FlatRateIsUsedForUnderallotmentPenaltyCalculation, CatalogRoomQuotas.FlatRateRoomType AS FlatRateRoomType, CatalogRoomQuotas.Hotel AS Hotel, CatalogRoomQuotas.IsCommitment AS IsCommitment, CatalogRoomQuotas.IsForCheckInPeriods AS IsForCheckInPeriods, CatalogRoomQuotas.IsQuotaForRooms AS IsQuotaForRooms, CatalogRoomQuotas.OverAllotmentContract AS OverAllotmentContract, CatalogRoomQuotas.OverAllotmentRoomRate AS OverAllotmentRoomRate, CatalogRoomQuotas.OverbookingIsNotAllowed AS OverbookingIsNotAllowed, CatalogRoomQuotas.PeriodFrom AS PeriodFrom, CatalogRoomQuotas.PeriodTo AS PeriodTo, CatalogRoomQuotas.PriceNumberOfAdults AS PriceNumberOfAdults, CatalogRoomQuotas.ReleaseTime AS ReleaseTime, CatalogRoomQuotas.Remarks AS Remarks, CatalogRoomQuotas.RoomRate AS RoomRate, CatalogRoomQuotas.Service AS Service, CatalogRoomQuotas.SortCode AS SortCode, CatalogRoomQuotas.TreatAsTentativeBooking AS TreatAsTentativeBooking, CatalogRoomQuotas.UnderAllotmentRoomRate AS UnderAllotmentRoomRate, CatalogRoomQuotas.UsePriceCalculationRoomTypeForAllotmentWriteOff AS UsePriceCalculationRoomTypeForAllotmentWriteOff, CatalogRoomQuotas.Predefined AS Predefined, CatalogRoomQuotas.PredefinedDataName AS PredefinedDataName, CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef AS DateOfDef, CASE WHEN CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.DefiniteNotGuaranteed) AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <= &qToday AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <> &qEmptyDate THEN 32 WHEN CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.Tentative) AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <= &qToday AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <> &qEmptyDate THEN 32 ELSE 0 END AS IsDue, CatalogRoomQuotas.ReservationManager AS ReservationManager, CatalogRoomQuotas.MICEManager AS MICEManager, CatalogRoomQuotas.RevenueManager AS RevenueManager, CatalogRoomQuotas.AuthorOfAnnulation AS AuthorOfAnnulation, CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfAnnulation AS DateOfAnnulation, CatalogRoomQuotas.AnnulationReason AS AnnulationReason, CatalogRoomQuotas.RoomNights AS RoomNights, CatalogRoomQuotas.BudgetADR AS BudgetADR, CatalogRoomQuotas.BudgetReservationAmount AS BudgetReservationAmount, CatalogRoomQuotas.BudgetMICEAmount AS BudgetMICEAmount, CatalogRoomQuotas.BudgetAmount AS BudgetAmount, CatalogRoomQuotas.BudgetCurrency AS BudgetCurrency FROM Catalog.RoomQuotas AS CatalogRoomQuotas WHERE CatalogRoomQuotas.Hotel IN(&qHotels) AND (CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentBusinessType = &qAllotmentBusinessType OR &qAllotmentBusinessType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentBusinessTypes.EmptyRef) AND CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentBusinessType <> VALUE(Enum.AllotmentBusinessTypes.BusinessBlock)) AND (CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType = &qAllotmentType OR &qAllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.EmptyRef)) AND CASE WHEN &qIsDueOnly AND CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.DefiniteNotGuaranteed) AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <= &qToday AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <> &qEmptyDate THEN TRUE WHEN &qIsDueOnly AND CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.Tentative) AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <= &qToday AND CatalogRoomQuotas.DateOfDef <> &qEmptyDate THEN TRUE WHEN &qIsDueOnly THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qShowCancelledAndDeleted THEN TRUE WHEN &qAllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.Cancelled) THEN NOT CatalogRoomQuotas.DeletionMark ELSE NOT CatalogRoomQuotas.DeletionMark AND NOT CatalogRoomQuotas.AllotmentType = VALUE(Enum.AllotmentTypes.Cancelled) END AND CatalogRoomQuotas.PeriodFrom <= &qDateTo AND CatalogRoomQuotas.PeriodTo >= &qDateFrom
